0022600150.text: The Grizzlies (5-0) come into this home game on a five-game winning streak, with a 1-0 home record and a 4-0 road record, and sit 2nd in the Southwest and 2nd in the West. The Sacramento Kings (0-5) are on a five-game losing streak, sit 15th in the West, and are 4 games back in the Pacific, where they are 5th. The Grizzlies lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after winning 123-112 in Sacramento on October 25, and they also won the 2025-26 series 3-1. Quinten Post is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision for Memphis, while Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), all listed as out.
